def-csm-frontier-abstract-polymer:
## Definition

An abstract polymer model consists of a countable set $\Gamma$, a reflexive symmetric relation $\sim$ on $\Gamma$, and an activity function $z:\Gamma\to\mathbb C$. Its elements are called polymers, and $\gamma\sim\eta$ means that the two polymers are incompatible. A subset $X\subseteq\Gamma$ is compatible when no two distinct elements of $X$ are related by $\sim$. For each finite $V\subseteq\Gamma$, define the finite-volume partition polynomial

$$Z_V(z):=\sum_{\substack{X\subseteq V\\X\text{ compatible}}}\ \prod_{\gamma\in X}z_\gamma,$$

where the empty subset contributes $1$.

For $n\geq1$ and an ordered tuple $(\gamma_1,\ldots,\gamma_n)\in\Gamma^n$, let $\mathcal C_n$ be the finite set of connected simple graphs with vertex set $\{1,\ldots,n\}$, put $f_{ij}:=-\mathbf 1_{\{\gamma_i\sim\gamma_j\}}$, and define the connected coefficient

$$U_n(\gamma_1,\ldots,\gamma_n):=\sum_{G\in\mathcal C_n}\ \prod_{\{i,j\}\in E(G)}f_{ij}.$$

For $n=1$, $\mathcal C_1$ contains the one-vertex graph and the empty edge product equals $1$. These are finite polynomial and coefficient definitions; they assert no convergence.
lem-csm-frontier-polymer-tree-majorant:
## Statement

Let $(\Gamma,\sim,z)$ be an abstract polymer model. Suppose $a:\Gamma\to[0,\infty)$ satisfies

$$\sum_{\eta\sim\gamma}|z_\eta|e^{a_\eta}\leq a_\gamma\qquad(\gamma\in\Gamma).$$

For each fixed root $\gamma\in\Gamma$, the nonnegative rooted connected-cluster sum

$$R_\gamma:=\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac1{(n-1)!}\sum_{\gamma_2,\ldots,\gamma_n\in\Gamma}|U_n(\gamma,\gamma_2,\ldots,\gamma_n)|\prod_{j=2}^n|z_{\gamma_j}|$$

is well-defined as a possibly extended nonnegative series and satisfies $R_\gamma\leq e^{a_\gamma}$.
thm-csm-frontier-polymer-analyticity:
## Statement

Let $\Gamma$ be countable with a reflexive symmetric incompatibility relation $\sim$. Let $V\subseteq\Gamma$ be finite, and fix weights $w_\gamma\in\mathbb C$, numbers $a_\gamma\geq0$, and a radius $r>0$. Call $X\subseteq V$ compatible when no two distinct elements of $X$ are related by $\sim$. Suppose there is $\varepsilon\in(0,1]$ such that

$$\sum_{\substack{\eta\in V\\\eta\sim\gamma}}r|w_\eta|e^{a_\eta}\leq(1-\varepsilon)a_\gamma\qquad(\gamma\in V).$$

For $t\in\mathbb C$, define $Z_V(t):=\sum_{\substack{X\subseteq V\ X\text{ compatible}}}\prod_{\gamma\in X}(tw_\gamma)$. Define the connected series

$$L_V(t):=\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{t^n}{n!}\sum_{\gamma_1,\ldots,\gamma_n\in V}U_n(\gamma_1,\ldots,\gamma_n)\prod_{i=1}^nw_{\gamma_i}.$$

Then $L_V$ converges absolutely and uniformly on every closed subdisc strictly inside $|t|<r$, may be differentiated there term by term, and satisfies $Z_V(t)=\exp(L_V(t))$ for $|t|<r$. Thus $Z_V$ has no zero in this disc and $L_V$ is its analytic logarithm normalized by $L_V(0)=0$.
lem-csm-frontier-stable-mayer-tree-bound:
## Statement

Assume the Axiom of Countable Choice. All displayed integrals use Lebesgue measure. Let $d\geq1$, let $v:\mathbb R^d\to\mathbb R\cup\{+\infty\}$ be an even Borel pair potential with no $-\infty$ values, and suppose it is stable with constant $B\geq0$. Fix $\beta>0$, set $e^{-c(+\infty)}:=0$ for every $c>0$, define the Mayer function $f_\beta(x):=e^{-\beta v(x)}-1$, and suppose

$$C_\beta:=\int_{\mathbb R^d}|f_\beta(x)|\,dx<\infty.$$

For $n\geq2$, let $\mathcal C_n$ be the connected simple graphs on $\{1,\ldots,n\}$ and put

$$U_n(x_1,\ldots,x_n):=\sum_{G\in\mathcal C_n}\ \prod_{\{i,j\}\in E(G)}f_\beta(x_i-x_j).$$

For every configuration $(x_1,\ldots,x_n)\in(\mathbb R^d)^n$,

$$|U_n(x_1,\ldots,x_n)|\leq e^{2\beta Bn}\sum_{T\in\mathcal T_n}\ \prod_{\{i,j\}\in E(T)}|f_\beta(x_i-x_j)|,$$

where $\mathcal T_n$ is the set of labelled trees on $\{1,\ldots,n\}$. In particular,

$$\int_{(\mathbb R^d)^{n-1}}|U_n(0,x_2,\ldots,x_n)|\,dx_2\cdots dx_n\leq e^{2\beta Bn}n^{n-2}C_\beta^{\,n-1}.$$
thm-csm-frontier-dilute-mayer-domain:
## Statement

Assume the Axiom of Countable Choice. All displayed integrals use Lebesgue measure. Fix $d\geq1$, an even Borel pair potential $v:\mathbb R^d\to\mathbb R\cup\{+\infty\}$ with no $-\infty$ values, stable with constant $B\geq0$, and $\beta>0$. Put $e^{-c(+\infty)}=0$ for every $c>0$, $f_\beta(x)=e^{-\beta v(x)}-1$, and $C_\beta=\int_{\mathbb R^d}|f_\beta(x)|\,dx<\infty$. For $n\geq2$, use

$$U_n(x_1,\ldots,x_n):=\sum_{G\in\mathcal C_n}\prod_{\{i,j\}\in E(G)}f_\beta(x_i-x_j),$$

where $\mathcal C_n$ is the set of connected simple graphs on $\{1,\ldots,n\}$; set $U_1=1$. For $L>0$, let $\Lambda_L=[-L,L]^d$ and write $|\Lambda_L|:=\lambda_d(\Lambda_L)=(2L)^d$; define

$$\Xi_L(z):=\sum_{N=0}^{\infty}\frac{z^N}{N!}\int_{\Lambda_L^N}\exp\!\left(-\beta\sum_{1\leq i<j\leq N}v(x_i-x_j)\right)\,dx_1\cdots dx_N,$$

with the $N=0$ term equal to $1$. Set $b_1(L)=1$ and, for $n\geq2$,

$$b_n(L):=\frac1{n!|\Lambda_L|}\int_{\Lambda_L^n}U_n(x_1,\ldots,x_n)\,dx_1\cdots dx_n.$$

Also set $b_1=1$ and, for $n\geq2$,

$$b_n:=\frac1{n!}\int_{(\mathbb R^d)^{n-1}}U_n(0,x_2,\ldots,x_n)\,dx_2\cdots dx_n.$$

Let $\mathcal D=\{z\in\mathbb C:|z|e^{2\beta B+1}C_\beta<1\}$ when $C_\beta>0$, and let $\mathcal D=\mathbb C$ when $C_\beta=0$. On $\mathcal D$, the finite-volume connected pressure series $p_L(z):=\sum_{n\geq1}b_n(L)z^n$ and the limiting Mayer pressure series $p(z):=\sum_{n\geq1}b_nz^n$ converge absolutely and locally uniformly, are differentiable term by term, and satisfy

$$\Xi_L(z)=\exp\!\bigl(|\Lambda_L|p_L(z)\bigr),\qquad \lim_{L\to\infty}p_L(z)=p(z).$$

The convergence and derivative limits are uniform on every compact subdisc of $\mathcal D$. The pressure limit here is along centered cubes only.
